metrics.name: Listings
metrics.description: Every listing in the snapshot, whether or not anyone has stayed recently.

metrics.name: Active listings
metrics.description: Listings with at least one review in the last 12 months. Most dormant listings never get booked.

metrics.name: Occupancy rate
metrics.description: Modelled booked nights in the last 12 months, as a share of the year, for active listings.

changelog.change: Denominator counted every listing, including dormant ones. Gave 13.5% and made London look empty.
Active listings only, so the rate describes listings that are actually trading.

metrics.name: Nights booked (modelled)
metrics.description: Modelled booked nights in the last 12 months, active listings.

metrics.name: Entire-home share
metrics.description: Share of active listings that are a whole home or flat, the type the 90-night rule is about.

metrics.name: Multi-listing host share
metrics.description: Share of active listings run by a host with two or more London listings.

metrics.name: Entire homes likely over 90 nights
metrics.description: Active entire homes, offered for short stays (minimum under 90 nights), modelled above 90 booked nights in the last 12 months.
metrics.filter: is_active and is_entire_home and is_short_let and modelled_nights > 90

metrics.name: Share of entire homes likely over 90 nights
metrics.description: Over-90 entire homes as a share of active short-stay entire homes.

metrics.name: Occupancy: calendar unavailable
metrics.description: Share of the next 365 days that are not open on the calendar, all listings.
metrics.why_not: The calendar cannot tell a booked night from one the host blocked, and it looks forward, not back. A dormant listing with a closed calendar looks fully booked.

metrics.name: Occupancy: modelled, all listings
metrics.description: Modelled booked nights as a share of the year, counting dormant listings too.
metrics.why_not: Half of all listings had no stay in a year. Counting them describes the size of the listing site, not how busy short lets are. This was version 1 of the certified metric.

metrics.name: Occupancy: booked share of bookable nights
metrics.description: Modelled booked nights divided by modelled booked plus open nights, active listings.
metrics.why_not: Mixes a backward-looking estimate (last 12 months) with a forward-looking calendar (next 12 months), so the two halves describe different years.
